paths.title: Agentic Systems Engineering: the core reading path
paths.rationale: This site runs several series in parallel, each working one thesis on its own timeline. This is the one throughline across them: five essays, read in order, that build a single argument about how agentic delivery actually has to work. Read each series for its own depth. Read this path when you want the throughline instead.

steps.title: The AI Productivity Paradox
steps.whatItAnswers: Why task-level AI gains stop compounding the moment work leaves one developer's machine.

steps.title: The Work Is a Graph
steps.whatItAnswers: The operating model that routes agentic work end to end instead of trapping it in one chat transcript.

steps.title: The Registry Wave Is Here
steps.whatItAnswers: Why the reusable artifacts agents run on need a supply chain, not just a registry.

steps.title: The Contract Is the Work
steps.whatItAnswers: Who is accountable when execution spans multiple agents and handoffs.

steps.title: The Deterministic Envelope
steps.whatItAnswers: How much of this can run unattended, and where the line has to hold.
